instruction: The italic text needs more prominence. Can you change all italicized words to be both bold and underlined?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making italic text bold and underlined. Verified 21 italic runs in document. Evaluator checks if all italic text has both bold and underline properties.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts DOCX file from VM using get_vm_file getter
Metric logic correctly iterates through all paragraphs and runs to find italic text
Verification logic properly checks both bold AND underline properties for each italic run
Complete coverage: checks ALL italic text in the document (21 runs mentioned in metadata)
Correct scoring: returns 1.0 only if correct_count == italic_count (all italic text is bold+underlined)
Proper edge case handling: returns 0.0 if no italic text found or document load fails
Appropriate postconfig: activates window and saves file (Ctrl+S) before verification
Filters empty text runs using run.text.strip() to avoid false positives
Expected value structure (empty rules) is appropriate since metric does complete verification internally
